name: Skyline DRIVE — Solid Bridge
author: Skate3clone
description: Collision generated from the existing rendered car model, replicated wheel animation, native impact classification, safe on-foot exits and 5-second re-entry cooldown. Requires matching Model Collision Repair engine update.

audio_enabled.label: Engine audio
audio_enabled.description: Enable all car sounds. Requires the native audio API update.

engine_volume.label: Engine master volume
engine_volume.description: Master gain for engine, turbo and exhaust. Start low.

pop_volume.label: Exhaust pop volume
pop_volume.description: Additional exhaust pop gain, multiplied by engine master volume.

redline_pops.label: Redline bangs and pops
redline_pops.description: Acoustic limiter chatter near redline; does not alter the soft-cut engine physics.

overrun_pops.label: Lift-off crackles
overrun_pops.description: Short, finite exhaust crackles after lifting at high RPM.

turbo_audio.label: Turbo spool and lift
turbo_audio.description: Procedural turbo whistle and lift-off sound.

show_driving_debug.label: Show car diagnostics (H)
show_driving_debug.description: Top-left physics diagnostics and controls. H toggles for this session. Does not hide the engine FPS overlay.

show_speedometer.label: Show speedometer
show_speedometer.description: Speed, selected gear, RPM bar and handbrake indicator while driving.

speed_mph.label: Speed in MPH
speed_mph.description: Off uses km/h. Speed is chassis road-plane speed, not spinning-wheel speed.

dashboard_scale.label: Dashboard scale
dashboard_scale.description: Scales the lower-right HUD. It also fits the current viewport.

camera_distance.label: Chase distance (m)
camera_distance.description: Base boom length. Dynamic speed framing adds up to 1.8 m.

camera_spring.label: Chase spring frequency (Hz)
camera_spring.description: Higher follows changes more tightly; lower gives more camera lag.

camera_fov.label: Chase vertical FOV (degrees)
camera_fov.description: Speed framing adds up to 8 degrees. Hood uses 60 degrees.

hood_height.label: Hood camera height (model m)
hood_height.description: Local camera height. Default is above the uploaded model hood.

steering_precision.label: High-speed stick precision
steering_precision.description: 0 restores the old stick curve. Gentler centre at speed, but full lock and opposite lock remain available. No automatic steering.

aero_enabled.label: Aerodynamic surface loads
aero_enabled.description: Explicit speed-squared fore/rear downforce. Tuned coefficient assumptions, not measured stock R34 data.

aero_front_area.label: Front Cl x area (m2)
aero_front_area.description: Positive produces downforce; negative produces lift. Independent of tire friction and camera.

aero_rear_area.label: Rear Cl x area (m2)
aero_rear_area.description: Positive produces downforce; negative produces lift. Default 0.12 is a modest tunable assumption.

show_collision_hull.label: Collision hull debug (J)
show_collision_hull.description: Draw actual local/remote solid colliders and physical centers of mass. J toggles during play.
